assumptions.statement: Official site and key-area polygons, Regulatory Detailed Planning controls, road redlines, ownership, buildings, utilities, fire access, heritage, trees, and engineering constraints are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves remain Conceptual Recommendations; official geometry triggers regeneration of every derived layer, metric, figure, page, and drawing.

assumptions.statement: No site visit, resident interview, accessibility co-test, building survey, device inventory, or operator interview was conducted for this submission.
assumptions.impact: The package defines verification objects and interfaces but makes no claim about existing service quality, demand, building condition, or public preference.

assumptions.statement: Named government, enterprise, university, community, maintenance, safety, data, and complaint-handling operators have not been appointed.
assumptions.impact: The three depots, twelve scenarios, annual Repair Season, phasing, staffing, budget, opening hours, and procurement clauses are operating prototypes only.

assumptions.statement: Area and ratio metrics are recalculated from provisional or participant-generated geometry in EPSG:4548; counts measure package completeness, not deployed performance.
assumptions.impact: Values may support topology review and design comparison but cannot be used as statutory controls, implementation KPIs, or evidence of operational success.
